llm.findings: [E1] expected: The flagged POST to xproof.app sends a file hash and filename for certification; that external transmission is central to the skill, documented in the privacy section, and paired with warnings not to send raw content or sensitive metadata.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want agents to create permanent public proof records and possibly spend USDC via x402. Use non-sensitive filenames, hash content locally, keep API keys out of logs and repositories, and configure human approval or spending caps before any autonomous certification workflow.
